symptom: A production task image has naturalWidth 0 in Web while its /api/media URL returns 200 and decodes
direct_cause: The renderer assembles nomi-local URLs after RPC translation and passes them directly to browser media sinks
class_root: Platform delivery depends on an incidental transport path instead of a host-owned consumption contract
affected_population: Web creators previewing production images, video posters, videos, audio, generated anchors or cached filmstrips
Web creators decoding project media in image, duration and export tools
internal_only_reason: The custom protocol, project media route and bridge capability table are Nomi-owned application contracts; no external library determines their mapping
invariants: Canonical project asset identity is stored as nomi-local://asset while Web consumption uses same-origin /api/media
Desktop consumption retains the custom protocol
Only project-owned media directories and file types can be served by the Web host

door_reduction.why_not: The distinct image, video, audio, browser decoder, owner parser and transport consumers remain separate presentation operations. All converge on the same mapping and reverse-identity owner; removing one would remove a distinct user workflow.

generality_proof: A single canonical-to-delivery mapper is shared by Web transport and renderer media consumers. It handles every project asset kind equally, preserves path/query bytes, and is idempotent for already translated RPC values. Unsupported custom schemes remain unsupported rather than being guessed as project files.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Select host-valid project media URL at browser consumption and recover same-origin canonical ownership
Permit only owned media paths at the Web HTTP read boundary

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Builds canonical URLs locally and passes them to DOM media sinks
Builds canonical URLs from artifacts locally after RPC transport
Shared image sink consumes RPC and renderer-generated URLs
Recovers project ownership from same-origin delivered Web URL for cross-project media

recurrence.reason: Any local URL built after RPC or future unsupported bridge method can repeat the defect
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs buildNomiLocalAssetUrl: two production writer doors
rg media DOM/decoder sinks across src/design, src/workbench, src/media
web bridge method comparison against web/rpc.ts command table

prevention.invariant: Project media delivery URL is valid for the current host without altering stored identity
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported schemes are not mapped to project files; unauthorized media paths fail with 404
prevention.strategy: Central mapping reused by RPC transport and media sinks; reverse mapping preserves owner identity and Web read policy limits project paths

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the duplicate browser-direction URL construction and delegate it to the shared mapper

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Nomi owns the protocol, route and bridge API

migration: Persisted canonical URLs stay canonical. Existing browser transport URLs remain valid and idempotent at sinks.
residual_risks: Actual browser and desktop media playback requires validation
Legacy file:// and signed production-preview URLs have no Web project asset mapping

invariant_owner_layer.why: The shared resolver owns platform delivery mapping; host capability exposure remains in the Web bridge.
